item.title: Man is shot and killed during Minneapolis immigration crackdown, National Guard activated
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — A federal immigration officer shot and killed a man Saturday in Minneapolis, drawing hundreds of protesters onto the frigid streets and ratcheting up tensions in a city already shaken by another fatal shooting weeks earlier.

item.title: Red Wings score four times in third period to ground Jets 5-1
item.description: WINNIPEG — J.T. Compher scored twice as the Detroit Red Wings defeated the Winnipeg Jets 5-1 in front of a sold-out crowd at Canada Life Centre Saturday night.

item.title: Geekie scores 100th career goal, Bruins beat Canadiens 4-3 to spoil Caufield's hat trick
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — Morgan Geekie scored his 100th career goal with 5:53 remaining to break a tie and give the Boston Bruins a 4-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.

item.title: Top-ranked Sabalenka powers her way into quarterfinals at Australian Open
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Top-ranked Aryna Sabalenka, attempting to win her third Australian Open title in four years, reached the quarterfinals on Sunday with a victory over No. 17 Victoria Mboko of Canada 6-1, 7-6 (1).

item.title: Natalie Portman, Seth Rogen debut new movies at Sundance Film Festival
item.description: PARK CITY, Utah (AP) — The comedy streak at the Sundance Film Festival continued Saturday with the world premieres of the art world satire “The Gallerist,” with Natalie Portman, and Oliva Wilde’s “The Invite,” a sharp look a crumbling marriage.

item.title: NHL roundup: Bruins unbeaten in seven at home after 4-3 win over Canadiens
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — Morgan Geekie scored his 100th career goal with 5:53 remaining to break a tie and give the Boston Bruins a 4-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.

item.title: American rock climber Alex Honnold reaches top of Taipei 101 skyscraper without ropes
item.description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — American rock climber Alex Honnold ascended the Taipei 101 skyscraper on Sunday without any ropes or protective equipment.

item.title: Bouchard brilliant as Edmonton Oilers down Washington Capitals 6-5 in OT
item.description: EDMONTON — Connor McDavid scored 46 seconds into overtime and the Edmonton Oilers held on for a wild 6-5 win over the Washington Capitals on Saturday.

item.title: Myanmar holds its last election round with the army already certain to keep control over government

item.title: Australia announces cull of dingoes that circled Canadian woman's body on beach
item.description: Government officials in Australia say a pack of dingoes found circling the body of a Canadian woman after her death on a beach on K'gari will be culled.
